messages:
Jordan (Sales): Hi all — first day! I don't see HubSpot or Dialpad in my app launcher and can't find the one-page enterprise call script. Who do I ping to get access and the quick playbook?
Priya (Sales Ops): Welcome Jordan :tada: 0% — I can take HubSpot. For Dialpad IT needs SSO+MFA verified first. Send your work email, manager, and role and I'll kick off provisioning. I'll also DM you the quick one-pager.
Jordan (Sales): jordan.kim@redwood.ai, manager: Lena Park, role: AE (Enterprise). Thanks Priya.
Priya (Sales Ops): Submitted HubSpot seat request (HS-3091). Opened Dialpad ticket DL-881 and flagged IT for MFA check. I attached the quick playbook PDF to your DM. ETA ~24h for Dialpad.
IT Helpdesk: Hi Jordan 0% we see DL-881. Please complete Okta MFA enrollment: https://okta.redwood.internal/enroll. Reply here when done and specify if you need the softphone app or a desk phone.
Jordan (Sales): Okta MFA done (just enrolled). I only need the softphone app and voicemail tied to my email.
IT Helpdesk: Done — Dialpad license active, extension 3821, voicemail forwarded to jordan.kim@redwood.ai. Softphone download link: https://dialpad.redwood/tools. If you hit audio issues, ping us with device/OS.
CS Oncall: Welcome Jordan! Short scripts and discovery checklist here: https://docs.redwood.com/sales/quick-scripts (I just shared the discovery checklist with Sales - Enterprise). Pro tip: start with customer pain, then map to our reduced-latency inference story. If you want a mock call, I can do a 20m roleplay later today.
Priya (Sales Ops): HubSpot Editor role granted; you should see the Enterprise pipeline, saved templates, and sequences. If you need reporting/dashboard access tell me which reports.
Welcome Bot: Onboarding checklist updated: Sales AE Day0 tasks marked complete (HubSpot, Dialpad, MFA). Calendar invites added: Sales Kickoff (30m), Product Overview (45m). Link: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/sales-ae.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks all. Alex/CS Oncall 1% can we do the roleplay? I'm free after 4pm.
CS Oncall: 4:30pm works — invite sent and I shared the discovery script in the thread. See you then!
Jordan (Sales): Perfect, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
